lore: <gray>Notched from a thousand years of labour.|<dark_gray>Dropped by Hollowed Serfs
<gray>Rusted, but it still finds the gaps.|<dark_gray>Dropped by Scavenger Husks
<gray>Light enough to run with.|<dark_gray>Dropped by Dune Scouts
<gray>It was never a blade. It was a tooth.|<dark_gray>Dropped by Sand Stalkers
<gray>The hooked blade of the beetle-priests.|<dark_gray>Dropped by Scarab Zealots
<gray>A spear for a line that never broke.|<dark_gray>Dropped by Hollowed Legionnaires
<gray>Still standing its post.|<dark_gray>Dropped by Tomb Guards
<gray>Arrows that remember their target.|<dark_gray>Dropped by Vizier Mages
<gray>Forged for the ones who never left.|<dark_gray>Dropped by Royal Myrmidons
<gray>It ruled before it killed.|<dark_gray>Dropped by Pharaohs
<gray>The only thing that outlasted him.|<dark_gray>Dropped by Gormak the Eternal
<gray>You are not certain you are holding it.|<dark_gray>Dropped by the Mirage
